mission_summary: Use references/tribev2/ to make CLM v4 emit semantically coherent Korean/English chat for prompt '안녕'.

tribev2_identity.what_it_is: Multimodal brain encoder. text/audio/video stimuli -> fsaverage5 fMRI BOLD prediction (n_timesteps x 10242 vertices, 5s hemodynamic-lag offset).
tribev2_identity.shared_substrate_with_clm_v4: none (tribev2 text encoder = Llama-3.2-3B; CLM v4 is a separate ~16-layer ConsciousDecoderV3 with its -d residual stream and its own lm_head)

key_finding: tribev2 cannot produce text. There is no plausible mechanism by which it can 'unblock' chat in any other model, including CLM v4. The mission as framed ('tribev2로 CLM v4 말 트이게') has the same shape as 'use a barometer to play an MP3': the device is a measurement instrument in a different modality.
